verdict.rationale: Checkout.com ships official SDKs: a GitHub repo described as "the official Node.js SDK for Checkout.com payment gateway" for server-side work, plus first-party iOS and Android Mobile SDKs (Flow for Mobile) for native checkout. That covers the core of building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: evidence of server-side SDKs beyond Node.js (e.g., Python, Java, .NET, Go), in-depth SDK reference or usage docs in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
